title: Plus Size Chiffon Ruffle Sleeve Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Step into elegance with our Plus Size Chiffon Ruffle Sleeve Wedding Guest Dress! This stunning piece features delicate ruffle sleeves and a flowing chiffon fabric that flatters every curve. Perfect for celebrating love, this dress combines comfort and style, ensuring you shine at any wedding event!


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Side zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
